reviewed_counterexamples.modeling:equality_cannot_be_forged: Both diagnostics reject reflexive equality between String and Bool; the valid equality control compiles.
reviewed_counterexamples.modeling:associated_family_wrong_mapping: The conformance error and same-type mismatch both reject mapping Int to TextSyntax.Value String.
reviewed_counterexamples.modeling:pack_wrong_arity: Missing-argument and pack-inference diagnostics arise at the same wrong-arity apply call.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:integer_arithmetic_default: The parser rejects an arithmetic expression as a generic integer argument; the secondary tuple-type diagnostic follows that parse failure.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:integer_generic_arithmetic: The parser rejects N + 1 as a generic integer argument under the default lane.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:integer_inequality_constraint: All parser and operator diagnostics arise from unsupported N > 0 generic constraint syntax in the one-line declaration.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:custom_lifetime_default: The nonescapable result and lifetime-attribute diagnostics reject the declaration without its experimental feature flag.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:literal_expression_experimental: The literal-expression feature accepts literal syntax but rejects the arithmetic operator in this expression.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:generic_arithmetic_experimental: The generic arithmetic expression has self-referential requirements and is not an integer literal expression; all errors concern N + 1.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:noncopyable_tuple: Both diagnostics reject noncopyable elements in the returned tuple.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:nonescapable_custom_struct: The synthesized getter and initializer cannot return the nonescapable result in this default-lane declaration.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:pack_noncopyable: Both diagnostics reject suppressing Copyable on each pack element.
reviewed_counterexamples.frontier:span_single_value: The same unsupported Span(borrowing: Int) construction emits a label mismatch and an Int-to-RawSpan mismatch for the available initializer.
